name: Git integration
description: A SQL Database in Microsoft Fabric has source control integration, or "git integration", allowing SQL users to can track the definitions of their database objects over time and across a team:* The team can commit the database to source control, which automatically converts the live database into code in the configured source control repository (Azure DevOps).* The team can update database objects from the contents of source control, which validates the code in Azure DevOps before applying a differential change to the database.
